orders.what: An order the customer placed: where it is, changing it before it ships, sending it back after it arrived
orders.not_for: A charge questioned for itself, a failed payment, signing in, a subscription
examples: Where is my parcel?
Cancel my order
How do I return the lamp?

delivery.what: A shipped order on its way or just arrived: where it is, when it comes, what happened to it in transit
delivery.not_for: Changing or cancelling an order, sending an item back
examples: Tracking has not moved in a week
The box arrived crushed

late.what: Not arrived yet: past the promised date, or tracking has stalled
examples: It was due Monday and it is Thursday
Stuck at the depot for six days

missing.what: Tracking says delivered but the customer does not have it, or the carrier lost it
examples: Marked delivered, nothing at my door
The courier says it was lost

damaged.what: Arrived broken, dented, wet or with parts missing
damaged.not_for: Arrived fine and the customer no longer wants it
examples: The mirror is cracked
The screws for the shelf were not in the box

changes.what: Changing or cancelling an order that has not shipped yet
examples: Cancel order 4411
Ship it to my office instead
Please cancel everything I ordered yesterday

edit.what: Change the address, an item, a colour, a size or a quantity
examples: Make it two cushions instead of one
Wrong postcode on my order

returns.what: Sending an item back after it arrived, and the refund for that return
returns.not_for: Items that never arrived or arrived broken
examples: How do I send this chair back?
I returned the rug, where is my money?

start.what: Wants to send something back: how, the label, whether it is allowed
examples: Can I return a sofa after 20 days?
I need a return label

refund.what: A return already sent back: whether it arrived, when the refund comes
examples: You got the parcel back last week and still no refund

billing.what: Money: a charge on the customer's card or statement, a payment that failed, the card on file
billing.not_for: The refund for an item sent back, which is orders; the subscription plan itself, which is account
examples: I was charged twice
My card keeps getting declined

charges.what: A charge already taken that the customer questions
charges.not_for: A payment that did not go through
examples: Why was I charged twice?
What is this charge?

duplicate.what: The same order or amount charged more than once
duplicate.not_for: One charge of the wrong amount
examples: Two identical charges of 59.90 for one order

unknown.what: A charge the customer does not recognise at all
unknown.not_for: A known order charged the wrong amount or twice
examples: There is a charge from you and I never ordered anything

amount.what: Charged a different amount than expected: a coupon not applied, a price that changed, shipping added
examples: My 20% code was not applied
The page said 45, I paid 52

payment.what: Paying: a payment that failed, or how the customer pays
examples: My card was declined at checkout
Update my card

declined.what: A payment failed or the card was declined
declined.not_for: Changing the card on file with nothing failing
examples: Checkout says payment failed but my bank says it is fine

method.what: Add, remove or update a card or other way to pay
examples: I got a new card, how do I change it?
Can I pay with PayPal?

account.what: The customer's account: signing in, security, the subscription plan, the personal data kept
account.not_for: A specific order or a specific charge
examples: I can't log in
Pause my subscription
Delete my data

access.what: Getting into the account and keeping it safe
access.not_for: Changing the subscription or personal data
examples: The reset link does not work
Someone logged into my account

login.what: Cannot sign in: forgotten password, reset link, locked out
examples: I forgot my password and the reset email never comes

security.what: Someone else got in, a suspicious sign-in or email, two-factor codes
security.not_for: The customer simply forgot the password
examples: I got a sign-in alert from another country
Skip next month's box
End my plan

change.what: Skip, pause, or change how often or what is delivered
examples: Send it every two months instead
Pause it while I travel
I want to end my subscription

privacy.what: The personal data the store keeps about the customer
examples: Delete everything you have on me

delete.what: Close the account and erase the data
examples: Please close my account and erase my details

export.what: A copy of the data held, or what is held and why
examples: Send me all the data you have about me
